mapper.select: select ag.Ag_Name as agName, mn.* from OA_Attendance_Weekday mn left join OA_Attendance_Group ag on ag.Ag_Id=mn.Ag_Id where mn.Ag_Id=#{agId} order by mn.Aw_Order asc

select ag.Ag_Name as agName, pp.PP_Name as ppName, dp.PD_Name as pdName, u.U_MTel as uMtel, u.U_Tel as uTel, c1.C_Name as Cname, c1.C_Name as cAbbName, mn.* from OA_Attendance_Member mn left join OA_Attendance_Group ag on ag.Ag_Id=mn.Ag_Id left join SYS_Position_P pp on pp.Pp_Id=mn.Pp_Id left join SYS_Department_P dp on pp.Pd_Id=dp.Pd_Id left join SYS_User u on u.U_ID=mn.Am_Uid left join SYS_Company c1 on u.C_ID=c1.C_ID where mn.Ag_Id=#{agId}

select pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Name_History as pNameHistory, proc.C_Name as pConsName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompDepName, mn.* from OA_Attendance_Group mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department where mn.Ag_Id=#{agId}
